author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m building a custom shower bench using 2-inch KERDI-BOARD. I install the supports every 9 inches and use KERDI-FIX for all the connections. After the bench is constructed I waterproof the seams and transitions to the wall/floor/tray with KERDI-BAND. This is very strong and can immediately be tiled over
title: Shower Bench Installation Tips - #shorts #showerremodel #sponsored
